title: Linked List Concept Quiz
description: A quick check to review the basic linked list concept.

questions.questionText: What does a linked list node usually contain?

options.text: A value and a reference to the next node

questions.explanation: A linked list node usually stores a value and a reference to the next node.

questions.questionText: What is the output of the following code?
questions.codeSnippet:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, value):
        self.value = value
        self.next = None

first = Node(10)
second = Node(20)
first.next = second

print(first.next.value)
questions.explanation: first.next points to the second node, and second.value is 20.
